title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Green Arch Passage direction + forward/back-only movement override

current_candidate.summary: Green Nave v8: taller/open immediate camera space, diagonal chamfered supports instead of square pillars, less nearby ceiling, fixed frontal view, forward/back only.

open_feedback: Current v8 is awaiting user review against the supplied green-arch reference and latest screenshot critique.
The visual target remains a very tall nave/cavity where repeated arches dominate more than columns.
Supports should read as diagonal/smooth transitions rather than square posts.
The near camera should feel open; little or no immediate ceiling slab should hang over the player.
Side walls must remain materially present and darkness should collect mainly in the distant center.
